newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota capital investment up by 10 pct in FY96/97.
newsitem.headline: Toyota capital investment up by 10 pct in FY96/97.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp will increase its capital spending in the current 1996 fiscal year by 10 percent to 330 billion yen from the previously planned amount, a Japanese business daily said on Sunday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the automaker needs to boost investment in research and development of new models to enhance competitiveness. The new figure for the year ending March 1997 would be up 13 percent from the previous fiscal year. It gave no source for its report.
To confront harsh competition at home, Toyota is expected to launch a record-high 13 to 14 new or updated models in 1997 to expand its market share from the current 39 percent, the newspaper said.
The company plans to mainly introduce new mini-vans and other recreational vehicle models, it said.
